chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The breast-feeding that builds the flesh and the blood is that which he breast-feeds until he is weary, and disinterested, and his breathing (sucking) ends.

key_terms.يُنْبِتُ اللَّحْمَ وَ الدَّمَ: Builds the flesh and blood (establishes physical kinship)

ai.seo_question: What is the defined duration of breast-feeding that establishes legal kinship in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the physiological threshold for establishing permanent kinship through breast-feeding (radha'), distinguishing it from mere temporary nourishment. It specifies that effective radha' requires the child to be fully satiated and to naturally cease sucking due to weariness, a criterion emphasized by Shia jurists to determine the validity of marriage prohibitions. This definition aligns with the broader Shia legal tradition which prioritizes the completion of the feeding process over a fixed number of times or months.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The breast-feeding is that which builds the flesh and the blood. It is that which he breast-feeds until he is weary, and disinterested, and his breathing (sucking) ends’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Breastfeeding that grows flesh and blood is the one that he drinks until he feels weary and disinterested and his breath ends.”’
